Title: Azure Cloud Services – Introducing support for Resource Health

Body.Content:
Azure Resource Health can now report live health status and status history on Portal for Azure Cloud Services deployments, roles & role instances. 

  • Azure Resource Health empowers you diagnose and get support for service problems that affect your Azure Cloud Service.
  • It reports on the current and past health of your resources at Deployment, Role & Role Instance level. 
  • It provides detailed reason for the health status change categorized primarily between Customer Initiated or Platform Initiated.
  • It enables you to setup alerts when the health status change.

Learn More about different health statuses and what scenarios they cover.
